text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the Arima Kinen.
At Rice Shower's request, we visited Kyoto Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, Big Brother.
Making you come all the way to Kyoto when it's not even a race day."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, Big Sister.
Making you come all the way to Kyoto when it's not even a race day."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to burn it into my memory.
This turf that I ran on so much.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because so many precious memories
are packed into this place.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, we were connected even before your debut race.
Come to think of it, we were connected even before your debut race.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Yeah. I went to watch the
Tenno Sho (Spring) with Bakushin O-san, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing McQueen-san look just like a blue rose...
Rice longed to become like that too..."
choice_data_list: And you too became a blue rose.
And you too became a blue rose.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hailed as Mihono Bourbon's rival
at the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At the Tenno Sho (Spring), she refused to kneel even before the figure she admired, blooming in all her glory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the Takarazuka Kinen, where everyone was on the verge of despair,
she personally showed the people what dreams are made of.
choice_data_list: Your exploits will be passed down like a story in a book
Your exploits will be passed down like a story in a book

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? T-That's being way too
overdramatic, Onii-samaaa...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? T-That's being way too
overdramatic, Onee-samaaa...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Geez, Dear Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Geez, Dear Sister.

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
"Mommyyy, hurry, hurry~!
Someone's gonna take the slide~!"

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, you'll trip if you rush like that.
Why don't you take turns playing with your friends?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...? ...A slide?
choice_data_list: There's also a park at this racetrack, after all.
There's also a park at this racetrack, after all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh~...! So that's why even on weekdays,
the little kids are—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, Big Brother.
Shouldn't we be heading home soon?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, Big Sister.
Shouldn't we be heading home soon?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Because... if it rains on account of Rice... everyone won't be able to play anymore... so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I confirmed that the chance of precipitation was 0% both yesterday and this morning. Besides, she is not a harbinger of misfortune...

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Then once we get to the park, we're playing Rice Shower! I get to be Rice-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, I wanna be Rice Shower too~!
You gotta switch after one turn, okay~?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Playing Rice Shower...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I have indeed heard rumors carried on the wind.
That lately, children who look up to Rice Shower
have taken to playing pretend as her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I never imagined I would
actually see it with my own eyes, but—"

text_block_list.name: Boy C
text_block_list.text: Hey, are you the real Rice Shower?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!?
Th-That's right, but...?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, are you the real Rice-chan!?
Awesome! Shake my hand, pleaseee!!

text_block_list.name: Boy C
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, when are you running next?
You're coming back to Kyoto again, right?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eeeh, eeeeeh...-!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Little kids came flocking
all around Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Surely, this admiration will carry on.
Just as Rice Shower first came to admire
Mejiro McQueen in the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Big Brother...?! 
Wh-Wh-What should Rice do...?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-Big Sister...!?
Wh-Wh-What should I do...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Unaccustomed to being surrounded by children,
Rice Shower furrowed her brows in distress,
so I decided to step in and back her up."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...! Yeah, that's true.
I guess... I just hope I can win here again.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...!
I-I'll be cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, thank you.
I'll do my best to live up to everyone's cheers."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower gently placed her hand on the young girl's head and slowly stroked her hair.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, hey, Big Brother.
Even if Rice doesn't make it into a book...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, hey, Big Sister.
Even if Rice doesn't make it into a book...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...It seems there are girls who remember me.
I'm so, so very blessed...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower broke into an utterly delighted smile.

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text:
Well, obviously!
I mean, Rice Shower is the pride of Kyoto!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Eh, um.
Ehhh...!?
choice_data_list: Hey, does everyone like Rice Shower?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Yup, love it!
I wanna be just like Rice-chan!

text_block_list.name: Boy C
text_block_list.text:
Me too! You run so fast and look so cool!
That's why I want to see you running here again!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The children gathered around Rice Shower had eyes full of wonder,
eagerly waiting for what their beloved Umamusume would say next.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Rice promises everyone.
I will definitely come back here again."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll run with everything I've got in front of everyone,
and cross the finish line in 1st place...!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Whoa...!! Really!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Really?
...Ehehe, Big Brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Really?
...Ehehe, Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: We just made another precious memory together... didn't we?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Surely from now on, and far into the future,
children who watch her run
will make her their dream.
